theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (g : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (Lg : NNReal) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (F G : Euclid P → Euclid n) (LG : NNReal) (T : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞), LipschitzWith Lg g → MeasurableSet A → InjOn g A → (∀ a ∈ A, DifferentiableAt ℝ g a) → IsOpen V → g '' A ⊆ V → LipschitzWith LG G → EqOn F G V → (∀ x ∈ g '' A, DifferentiableAt ℝ F x) → (∀ᵐ a ∂(volume.restrict A), T (g a) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ g a : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) → AEMeasurable h (μHE[n].restrict (g '' A)) → AEMeasurable (fun y : Euclid n => ∑' x : ↥(g '' A ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) volume ∧ ∫⁻ y, (∑' x : ↥(g '' A ∩ F ⁻¹' {y}), h x) ∂volume = ∫⁻ x in g '' A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin (Module.finrank ℝ (T x)) => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ F x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (T x) i)) (fderiv ℝ F x (stdOrthonormalBasis ℝ (T x) j))))) * h x ∂μHE[n]
